pathways: regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: CDKN1B encodes cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1B. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and molecular function inhibitor activity. It participates in regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to multiple endocrine neoplasia type 4 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Jejunoileal neuroendocrine tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
